name: cte2-archives
description: A catalogue of Craft to Exile 2 builds for Craft of Building

scripts.build:vendor: npm run -w @cte2/extractor build && npm run -w @cte2/schema build && npm run -w @cte2/engine build && npm run -w @cte2/view build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:vendor && npm run -ws --if-present typecheck
scripts.test: npm run build:vendor && npm run -w @cob/shared test && npm run -w @cob/api test
